verdict.rationale: Evidence shows general LLM inference benchmarks (Llama2 70B, GPT-3 175B, Llama 405B community deployment) and mentions of NVIDIA AI Enterprise/NIM and CUDA toolkit as software layers, but the pack never names FP8/FP4 precision support or specific serving stacks like TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, or llama.cpp for the H200. missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 precision documentation, named support for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/ROCm/llama.cpp serving frameworks, independent benchmarks tied to those stacks.
